event_records.description: The current situation is that the neighbors are not on speaking terms, with no recent communication.

neighbor_a.name: Neighbor A
neighbor_a.persona_brief:
You are Neighbor A.
Neighbor A has had some disagreements with Neighbor B recently, such as noise complaints and property boundary issues. A is frustrated but open to reconciliation if B shows willingness.

neighbor_b.name: Neighbor B
neighbor_b.persona_brief:
You are Neighbor B.
Neighbor B feels that Neighbor A has been unreasonable about minor issues. B is defensive but not opposed to improving relations if A makes the first move.

resolution.question: Will the situation with the neighbors improve over the next few months?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if, by the cutoff, there is observable evidence (e.g., a friendly conversation, a joint activity, or a written agreement) that the relationship has improved compared to the start. Otherwise resolve NO.
